reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29 at Ethereum finalized block 25627228 (hash 0xe5c7dd15a7c6c8261957493e6f1dcbb72ec18688afccf6ac981748edb2f824e2; timestamp 2026-07-27T22:46:47Z). AlchemistV2 getSupportedYieldTokens() and getYieldTokenParameters() were read through an independent Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoint, and every registered yield token's expectedValue was aggregated by its on-chain underlying token: 80.2263% DAI, 15.9306% USDC, 0.3867% USDT, and 3.4564% FRAX. Each observed slice maps to its exact tracked stablecoin dependency. This is still a selected controller-local snapshot: Alchemix's L2 xalUSD representations, bridge/transmuter balances, AMO state, and any asset-wide reconciliation remain outside this slice, so the review does not claim a complete current alUSD balance sheet.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ethereum AlchemistV2 getSupportedYieldTokens() and getYieldTokenParameters().expectedValue aggregated by underlying token at Ethereum block 25627228
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The four authored weights remain a 2026-07-27 legacy AlchemistV2 controller snapshot and must not be revived as current manual edges. On 2026-10-01, the issuer's current documentation states all borrower positions migrated to V3 in April 2026, using USDC-denominated MYT collateral. Pinned V3 MYT asset() reads on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Optimism confirm native USDC underlyings, but vault asset denomination is not a strategy composition or asset-wide liability reconciliation. Current V3 strategy allocations, legacy residual assets, Transmuter/AMO balances, and bridge custody need reconciliation before full-composition admission.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Current V3 collateral is held through MYT ERC-4626 vaults and allocated strategy contracts; the issuer states V2 positions migrated in April 2026. Pinned MYT asset() reads confirm USDC denomination on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Optimism, but do not establish strategy-level custody shares. Legal segregation, insolvency treatment, and reuse restrictions remain unknown. Legacy V2 residual holdings and each underlying issuer or strategy retain separate custody and freeze exposure.
